title: HTTP Relay Client Service State
description: Polls a server-side relay endpoint and serves responses to incoming HTTP requests by running them through a configurable inner pipeline. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/http-relay-client)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

pollUrl.description: URL to poll for pending requests

respondUrl.description: URL to POST the pipeline result back to

authVaultKey.description: Vault key for an optional bearer token injected into poll/respond requests

bypassAfterNumberOfPolls.description: Auto-bypass after this many polls; null to disable

pipeline.description: Inner pipeline applied to each incoming request's query params
